en: Black‑and‑white winter scene showing a line of box freight cars in the snow, loaded with supplies. Several uniformed men sit or stand in the open doors of the wagons, with one wagon marked by a Red Cross sign. On the left, a horse-drawn sled or cart is being unloaded, watched by men in long coats. Handwritten text appears across the upper part of the image, including a date of 1917.
